<thought>Based on the single measurement (6.667 Ω between A and X1) and the note that the subnetwork contains two resistors where one is twice the other, the only simple topology that fits is two resistors in series. Let the smaller resistor be R1 and the larger be R2 = 2·R1. Then R1 + R2 = 3·R1 = 6.667 Ω → R1 ≈ 2.222 Ω and R2 ≈ 4.444 Ω. The series connection can be represented with an intermediate node B between A and X1.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.444}, "connections": [["A","B","R1"], ["B","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
